behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer. Counter dword [rdi+0x1734], accumulator word [rdi+0x1730] (high byte at [rdi+0x1731]), output buffer pointer [rdi+0x10], write position qword [rdi+0x28]. The window writes only through the buffer pointer and the counter/accumulator/position fields; it returns nothing (void drain).

edges.above_range_same_path: counter 17, acc 0x1234, pos 3 -> emit 0x34, counter 9, acc 0x12, pos 4. The branches route any counter other than exactly 16 and signed <= 7 to the one-byte path, so a counter above 16 (outside the valid 0..16 range) takes the same path; the model restates the branches, not a range assumption.
edges.flush: counter 16, acc 0xabcd, pos 5 -> emit 0xcd then 0xab, pos 7, acc 0, counter 0.
edges.flush_zero: counter 16, acc 0x0000, pos 0 -> emit 0x00, 0x00, pos 2, acc 0, counter 0.
edges.no_emit_boundary: counter 7, acc 0xffff, pos 4 -> no emit, all fields unchanged.
edges.no_emit_negative: counter -1 (signed jle), acc 0x1234, pos 4 -> no emit, all fields unchanged.
edges.no_emit_zero: counter 0, acc 0x1234, pos 4 -> no emit, all fields unchanged.
edges.one_byte_high: counter 15, acc 0x00ff, pos 9 -> emit 0xff, pos 10, counter 7, acc 0x00.
edges.one_byte_low: counter 8, acc 0x1234, pos 3 -> emit 0x34, pos 4, counter 0, acc 0x12.
edges.one_byte_mid: counter 9, acc 0x8001, pos 0 -> emit 0x01, pos 1, counter 1, acc 0x80.

behavior.entry_shape: endbr64, counter load, two compares with forward branches (je to the flush path, jle to the no-emit ret), a one-byte path, a 2-byte intra-FDE alignment nop (xchg %ax,%ax at 0x549408e) between the one-byte ret and the flush path, then the flush path; no call opcode inside the window.
behavior.gate_detail: Counter == 16 takes the flush path (both accumulator bytes emitted, accumulator and counter reset). Signed counter <= 7 takes the no-emit ret. Every other counter value takes the one-byte path (low byte emitted, position += 1, counter -= 8, accumulator word >>= 8). In the valid 0..16 counter range the one-byte path covers exactly 8..15; the two paths leave different state (flush clears, one-byte shifts), so they must not be merged.
behavior.return_rule: Void drain. If counter == 16: emit the low byte of the accumulator word, then its high byte ([rdi+0x1731]), position += 2, accumulator word = 0, counter = 0. Else if counter <= 7 (signed): emit nothing, change nothing. Else: emit the low byte of the accumulator word, position += 1, counter -= 8, accumulator word >>= 8 (logical word shift).

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.caller_setup: Each of the 26 sites was confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start (the retained caller.objdump.txt shows each call as an instruction). Caller argument setup is caller-specific and its purpose is not claimed.
incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly 26 sites found, all in exactly 4 caller FDEs. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
